business_overview.one_sentence: Group operates mainly as a Singapore subcontractor for structural reinforced and concrete works, with labour supply, tiles sales and Hong Kong mobile phone distribution businesses.

segments.name: Sales of mobile phones and accessories

business_overview.revenue_model: Construction contract revenue recognized over time when work progress is measurable; mobile phone distribution revenue recognized when control of goods transfers to customers.
business_notes: 928 full-time staff at 31 Dec 2025, mainly in Singapore; group entered mobile phone distribution as a pure distributor, not manufacturer or retailer.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year net profit median is S$1.944m, but free cash flow after capex falls from S$5.766m in 2023 to S$1.367m in 2024 and -S$0.259m in 2025. Contract assets and prepayments consumed cash in 2025, partly offset by trade payables. Use a material haircut to the profit denominator.
